exact_errors.root_cause: mvp-readiness.yml uses ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }} and ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL_TEST }}, but these secrets do not exist in the GitHub Actions environment
exact_errors.consequence: DATABASE_URL resolves to empty string, causing npm run build to fail in mvp-readiness-check.sh
exact_errors.build_failure_message: Build requires DATABASE_URL for Prisma client generation and schema validation

database_url_source: attempted to use non-existent GitHub secrets

root_cause_detailed.ci_yml_comparison: ci.yml correctly uses PostgreSQL service container with hardcoded test DATABASE_URL (safe for CI)

fix_strategy.approach: Add PostgreSQL 16 service container to MVP readiness workflow, same as ci.yml uses
fix_strategy.reasoning: A hardcoded test database URL in CI workflow is safe and standard practice. No secrets are needed for local/test database.
steps: Add services.postgres block to readiness-check job in mvp-readiness.yml
Remove reference to ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }} and ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL_TEST }}

also_inspect.note: ci.yml build-and-test jobs are also failing. This needs separate investigation. May be due to test environment issues or resource constraints.
